page_title: REI 1-0 TOU | Reims v Toulouse 20/04/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.
90+4' Cristian Casseres (Toulouse) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.

90+4' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety. It will be a corner kick for Toulouse.
90+2' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) picks out Djibril Sidibe with a fine lofted pass, but the latter wasn't able to create some space to get into shooting range.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' Junya Ito (Reims) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
87' The game is interrupted now, Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
85' Carles Martinez has decided to substitute Aron Donnum and he is replaced by Shavy Babicka (Toulouse).
85' A dangerous looking corner kick from Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) is cleared to safety by the defence.
84' The Toulouse players are exchanging some short passes.
83' The referee allows time for a substitution. Buta will be replaced by Malcolm Jeng (Reims).
82' Buta (Reims) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
81' Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball.
79' Samba Diawara decides to make a substitution. Keito Nakamura will be replaced by Mamadou Diakhon (Reims).
79' Here comes a substitution. Amadou Kone is given a rest as he is replaced by Ange Tia (Reims).
78' Hafiz Ibrahim (Reims) latches onto a lofted pass near the penalty spot only to head the ball yards wide of the left post.
78' Hafiz Ibrahim (Reims) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
76' Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) has a goal ruled out for offside!
75' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
74' The foul by Gabriel Moscardo (Reims) is worthy of a card and a yellow is duly shown by Marc Bollengier.
73' Close! A mistake by a defender gifts Frank Magri (Toulouse) a chance inside the box, but his efforts curls just around the right post.
70' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Zakaria Aboukhlal (Toulouse) comes onto the pitch so that Yann Gboho can be given a rest.
70' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Marc Bollengier who sees an offensive foul.
69' Sergio Akieme (Reims) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.
68' Junya Ito (Reims) fails to beat the offside trap and the linesman puts his flag up.
67' Rough tackle by Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
66' Hafiz Ibrahim (Reims) makes a rough challenge and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul.
65' The ball is cleared after Gabriel Moscardo (Reims) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.

63' Junya Ito (Reims) runs with the ball towards the keeper and pulls the trigger from close range, but Guillaume Restes anticipates his intention and makes an amazing save to stop the shot going low into the middle of the target.
62' Samba Diawara has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Hafiz Ibrahim (Reims) replacing Jordan Siebatcheu.
62' Substitution. Nhoa Sangui makes way for Gabriel Moscardo (Reims).
61' OFF THE BAR! Junya Ito (Reims) unleashes a thunderous effort from the edge of the box and the ball crashes off the woodwork. What a strike that was!
60' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
59' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Yehvann Diouf comes off the line to clear the ball away.
58' Toulouse are playing some nice combination football, sending it precisely from player to player, but a defender shows good anticipation and ends the move with a good block.
56' Nhoa Sangui (Reims) sends a pass into the box, but the opposition's defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
54' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) tricks his way to the edge of the box where he shoots at goal. The keeper scrambles to cover the effort, but it goes just wide of the left post.
53' Sergio Akieme (Reims) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it. The ball is out of play. Toulouse will take a throw-in.
52' Jordan Siebatcheu (Reims) is flagged for offside.
50' Buta (Reims) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle.
49' A clumsy foul by Aron Donnum (Toulouse) and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle.
48' A pass by Keito Nakamura (Reims) ends up in no man's land, and the attacking effort comes to an end.
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+3' Marc Bollengier blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45+2' The corner from Frank Magri (Toulouse) is intercepted by the defence.
45+1' The corner from Frank Magri (Toulouse) is hurriedly cleared. Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.

45+1' Gabriel Suazo (Toulouse) delivers a long ball, but it lacks enough power to reach his teammates and is intercepted by one of the defenders. The ball goes out of play. Toulouse are awarded a corner kick.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
44' The Reims players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
42' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) shoots from the edge of the penalty area. The ball travels towards the middle of the target, but Yehvann Diouf easily deals with the threat.
41' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) tries to send a low pass into the box, but it's blocked and cleared.
39' 1 - 0 Jordan Siebatcheu (Reims) jumps for a cross and plants a perfect header inside the right post.
36' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) makes a strong challenge and Marc Bollengier blows for a foul.
34' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Umit Akdag (Toulouse) comes onto the pitch for Joshua King.
34' The game is interrupted now, Guillaume Restes (Toulouse) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
33' Frank Magri (Toulouse) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.

32' Frank Magri (Toulouse) is strong enough to get to the ball and produces a header from close range. Even though the header was directed to the left side of the goal, Yehvann Diouf didn't have a hard time stopping the attempt as it wasn't powerful enough. The ball is out of play and Toulouse manage to earn a corner.
32' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Toulouse comes to nothing.
32' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out. Toulouse force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
30' Keito Nakamura (Reims) produces a cross from the resulting free kick from just outside the box, but the goalkeeper smothers the ball.
27' What an awful challenge. The referee Marc Bollengier has no other option than to send Mark McKenzie (Toulouse) off the pitch. Red card!
26' A long cross into the box finds Joshua King (Toulouse) unmarked, but his header from the edge of the six-yard box is wild and goes miles wide of the left post.
25' Yann Gboho (Toulouse) delivers a low pass into the box which is intercepted.
24' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Keito Nakamura (Reims) heads on.
22' Charlie Cresswell (Toulouse) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
22' The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Toulouse.
21' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
19' Sergio Akieme (Reims) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
18' Joshua King (Toulouse) sees an unmarked teammate and attempts to send him a low pass. However, one of the defenders reads the game perfectly and averts the danger.
17' Joshua King (Toulouse) gets inside the box and tries to beat Yehvann Diouf with a measured shot into the bottom left corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.
16' Reims control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
13' Jordan Siebatcheu (Reims) commits a rough challenge and Marc Bollengier blows his whistle for a foul.
12' Flag up against Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse). He had space to move into behind the defence, but he went too soon.
11' Toulouse failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
10' The resulting set piece from Toulouse is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players. Toulouse have been awarded a corner kick.
8' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
6' Vincent Sierro (Toulouse) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
5' Reims seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
3' Djibril Sidibe (Toulouse) attempts to find one of his teammates with a fine lofted pass, but the defence reacts well to intercept the effort.
1' Amadou Kone (Reims) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
1' The match has just started.
Reims will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Marc Bollengier.
